summary_en: ¥795/share tender offer by Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited. Minimum 5,408,800 shares (17.89% of shares outstanding). Period: Aug 27 – Oct 13, 2026. Purpose: delisting and going private. Board recommends shareholders tender. Intended outcome: offeror and lead shareholder Ryuji Arai sole shareholders post-completion.
title_en: Notice on Board Opinion Supporting Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited and Recommendation to Shareholders to Tender
translation_en_brief: On 26 August 2026, SEED Co. announced a board resolution supporting a public tender offer by Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Luxshare Precision Limited, a China-based electronics manufacturing company) for SEED's ordinary shares at ¥795 per share. The tender offer is scheduled to run from 27 August to 13 October 2026 (30 business days). The minimum acquisition target is 5,408,800 shares, representing 17.89% of shares outstanding (calculated on a base of 302,411 voting rights as of 31 March 2026). There is no upper limit stated. The board recommends that shareholders tender. The transaction is intended to result in delisting (上場廃止) of SEED from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. Post-completion, the sole shareholders will be the offeror and Ryuji Arai, SEED's lead shareholder. The offeror parent will provide up to ¥13.0 billion in funding by the business day before settlement. The board resolution was adopted with unanimous approval of independent directors and without objection from independent auditors.
